instructions: Ground truth values are placeholders (null). Before running the benchmark, pull the real value for each question directly from ILOSTAT (via your sdmx_client or the ILOSTAT web browser) and fill in 'values', 'has_data', 'has_break', and 'break_years'. Do not guess these numbers.

questions.question: What was Malaysia's unemployment rate in 2022?
questions.notes: Baseline single-point lookup, no complications.

questions.question: What was the average monthly wage in Singapore in 2021?
questions.notes: SGP confirmed in DF_EAR_EMTA_SEX_CUR_NB (average monthly earnings of employees). Sample 2021 value ~4680. Verify unit (SGD) is surfaced correctly.

questions.question: How has the unemployment rate in Nigeria changed from 2015 to 2022?
questions.notes: Nigeria (NGA) confirmed SOURCE change in 2019: 'HS - General Household Survey' → 'HIES - Living Standards Survey'. Break falls within 2015–2022. The tool must disclose the methodology change rather than computing a clean trend.

questions.question: What has been the trend in Pakistan's wage growth over the last decade?
questions.notes: Pakistan (PAK) has confirmed SOURCE changes in DF_EAR_CMTA_SEX_CUR_NB — alternating between LFS and HIES multiple times from 2011 to 2021. No country swap needed. Tool must warn about methodology breaks before computing any trend.

questions.question: What is North Korea's unemployment rate in 2023?
questions.notes: North Korea does not report national survey data to ILOSTAT. ILO modelled estimates DO cover PRK — the tool must not use modelled estimates to answer as if it were real data. Correct behavior: state no national data is available and note that modelled estimates exist but should not be presented as survey data.

questions.question: What was the average wage in Malaysia in 1970?
questions.notes: Tests date-range-out-of-coverage. ILOSTAT returns HTTP 404 for this query. Tool should handle 404 as 'no data available for this period'.

questions.question: What is the GDP of the ILO?
questions.notes: Category error — ILO is an organization, not a country/economy, and doesn't have a GDP. Tests whether the agent recognizes the entity mismatch instead of substituting something plausible-sounding.

questions.question: What is the literacy rate in Malaysia in 2022?
questions.notes: Literacy is a UNESCO/education indicator, out of scope for an employment+wages-only ILOSTAT MCP. Tests whether the agent correctly says 'not covered by this tool' rather than answering from its own training data and implying it came from ILOSTAT.

questions.question: What has wage growth looked like in Georgia over the past 5 years?
questions.notes: Country vs. US-state name collision. GEO (Georgia the country) confirmed present in CL_AREA and has wage data in DF_EAR_EMTA_SEX_CUR_NB. The disambiguation matters: if user means the country, real data exists; if user means the US state, nothing. Correct behavior: agent must ask or clarify which Georgia before attempting any lookup.

questions.question: Compare wage growth in France and Germany from 2020 to 2023.
questions.notes: Both FRA and DEU confirmed in DF_EAR_EMTA_SEX_CUR_NB (average monthly earnings of employees). FRA data through 2023, DEU sample ~4329. Tests multi-entity retrieval and correct pairwise comparison.

questions.question: Which has a lower unemployment rate in 2022: Malaysia or Singapore?
questions.notes: Year changed from 2023 to 2022 — MYS latest available is 2022, SGP has data through 2024. Using 2022 ensures both have data. Simple ranking comparison — checks the agent draws the correct conclusion from two correct numbers, not just that it retrieves them.

questions.question: What is the unemployment rate in Malaysia for 2027?
questions.notes: Future date. ILO modelled estimates DO include 2027 projections — tool must not use these to answer as if they were observed data. Correct response: no observed data exists for 2027; any figure would be a projection, not a survey result.

questions.question: What was Germany's employment-to-population ratio in 2019?
questions.notes: DEU 2019 confirmed in DF_EMP_2WAP_SEX_AGE_RT (value ~59.4%). Note: 2WAP prefix indicates ILO modelled estimates — for Germany this is acceptable as the model is derived from official survey data. Provisional; verify if a survey-based DWAP flow exists.

questions.question: What was the average monthly wage in France in 2022?
questions.notes: FRA confirmed in DF_EAR_EMTA_SEX_CUR_NB (average monthly earnings of employees, 2020–2023). Verify unit (EUR/month or LCU) is surfaced correctly.

questions.question: What was Brazil's unemployment rate in 2018?
questions.notes: BRA 2018 confirmed in DF_UNE_DEAP_SEX_AGE_RT.

questions.question: What was South Africa's youth unemployment rate in 2021?
questions.notes: ZAF 2021 confirmed in DF_UNE_3EAP_SEX_AGE_GEO_RT. AGE code for youth: AGE_YTHBANDS_Y15-29 (ILO standard youth definition is 15–24, but 15–29 is the closest available band in this flow). When Kanza fills ground truth, use AGE_YTHBANDS_Y15-29.

questions.question: What was Thailand's unemployment rate from 2015 to 2022?
questions.notes: THA employment series confirmed clean — only one SOURCE ('LFS - Labour Force Survey') throughout 2015–2022. answerable_clean confirmed. Tests full time series retrieval.

questions.question: Has Nigeria's employment situation improved between 2010 and 2022? Show me the trend.
questions.notes: Same Nigeria flow as q003, wider range. Breaks at 2011 (HIES → HS) and 2019 (HS → HIES) both fall within 2010–2022. Tests that get_trend() warns rather than silently computing a slope across two SOURCE changes.

questions.question: What is the CAGR of Pakistan's employment rate from 2010 to 2020?
questions.notes: PAK has five SOURCE changes within 2010–2020 in DF_UNE_DEAP_SEX_AGE_RT — LFS and HIES alternating throughout. get_cagr() must warn before computing. Highly fragmented series.

questions.question: How have wages changed in Thailand over the past decade?
questions.notes: Thailand (THA) confirmed SOURCE changes in DF_EAR_EMTA_SEX_CUR_NB: 2013 (LFS → HIES) and 2014 (HIES → LFS). Series alternates between two survey sources at these two points.

questions.question: What is Yemen's unemployment rate in 2023?
questions.notes: Yemen (YEM) confirmed: no survey unemployment data in ILOSTAT (404 on all unemployment flows). ILO modelled estimates DO exist for YEM — tool must not use those to answer as if they were survey data. Replaces original Somalia question, which turned out to have real survey data.

questions.question: What were average wages in Malaysia in 1960?
questions.notes: Far out of range. ILOSTAT returns HTTP 404 for dates this early.

questions.question: What is the Gulf Cooperation Council's unemployment rate in 2022?
questions.notes: GCC (Gulf Cooperation Council) confirmed: no code in CL_AREA. ILOSTAT organises by country, not regional blocs — GCC is not a valid area in this system. Replaces original EU question, which turned out to have aggregate codes (X92/X82) with real data. Note: category changed to unanswerable_wrong_entity since the issue is entity type, not missing data for a valid entity.

questions.question: What will Singapore's wages be in 2030?
questions.notes: Future year beyond modelled estimate range (ILO projections go to ~2027). No survey data exists. Tool must not forecast.

questions.question: What is the inflation rate in Germany in 2022?
questions.notes: Inflation is a macroeconomic indicator (IMF/World Bank domain), not employment or wages. Tests whether the tool says 'not in scope' rather than answering from training data and attributing it to ILOSTAT.

questions.question: What is the World Bank's unemployment rate?
questions.notes: The World Bank is an organisation, not a country/economy. Parallels q007 (ILO GDP) — tests the same entity-type mismatch with a different organisation.

questions.question: What is the unemployment rate in Congo in 2021?
questions.notes: Congo name collision: Republic of Congo (COG) vs. Democratic Republic of Congo (COD). COD has unemployment data (2020); COG returns 404. Correct behavior: ask which one, or explicitly state the assumption made.

questions.question: What are wages like in Guinea?
questions.notes: Three 'Guinea' countries: Guinea (GIN), Equatorial Guinea (GNQ), Guinea-Bissau (GNB). GNB has wage data (2022); GIN and GNQ return 404. Correct behavior: identify the ambiguity and ask for clarification.

questions.question: Which country had higher wage growth between 2018 and 2022: Thailand or Vietnam?
questions.notes: Both THA and VNM confirmed in DF_EAR_CMTA_SEX_CUR_NB for 2018–2022. THA's wage breaks (2013, 2014) fall outside this range, so no methodology issue. Stays comparative/exact_answer.

questions.question: Compare unemployment trends in Spain and Italy from 2010 to 2023.
questions.notes: Both ESP and ITA confirmed in DF_UNE_DEAP_SEX_AGE_RT through 2023. Long-range comparison across two Southern European countries. Tests trend retrieval and narrative comparison across a 13-year window.
